scripts.name: example-all.welcome
scripts.source:
local ____lyracore_handler
local events = { package = { on = function(name, handler) ____lyracore_handler = handler end } }
-- A positive Script Answer sends the welcome. Zero suppresses it.
local function welcome(event)
    return 1
end

events.package.on("welcome", welcome)
assert(event.name == "example-all.welcome", "Event Binding does not match the Invocation")
return ____lyracore_handler(event)
